# Flowen

Flowen is a browser-based speech practice platform operated by Flowen Speech Technologies Ltd. It includes guided exercises, live acoustic feedback and session history.

Feedback is estimated, not diagnostic. No clinical outcome, fixed latency, NHS approval, funding eligibility or released native app is claimed. Some features transmit audio to providers or store recordings; see https://www.flowen.digital/legal for the privacy policy.

Product: https://www.flowen.digital/how-it-works
Pricing and trial terms: https://www.flowen.digital/pricing
Safety status: https://www.flowen.digital/security
Enquiries: hello@flowen.digital
